issue_description: customer_id identifies one order-associated customer record; customer_unique_id can span orders.
evidence: 99,441 unique customer_id; 96,096 unique customer_unique_id; 2997 stable IDs map to multiple records; maximum 17.
analytical_risk: Using customer_id as a stable identity understates repeat behavior.
proposed_treatment: Use customer_unique_id only after Phase 3 eligibility rules.

issue_title: Orders without related item, payment, or review records
issue_description: Parent orders do not always have each optional/transactional child source.
evidence: without items=775; payments=1; reviews=768; no child FK orphans.
analytical_risk: Metric populations and denominators can differ by source coverage.
proposed_treatment: Preserve orders; Phase 3 defines metric-specific eligibility.

issue_description: Directly joining both multi-row facts on order_id repeats measures by I_o × P_o.
evidence: 9,802 multi-item orders; 2,936 multi-payment orders; 275 both; 117,601 joined rows; price +4.544062%; payment +28.15711%.
analytical_risk: Can materially corrupt monetary metrics and conclusions.
proposed_treatment: Separate facts or independently pre-aggregate each to order grain.

affected_columns: review_id; order_id; review_score; review timestamps; comments
issue_description: Review IDs can link to multiple orders and orders can contain multiple review IDs; no revision flag exists.
evidence: 789 review IDs span orders; 547 orders have multiple review IDs; score variation among repeated review IDs=0; max rows/order=3.
analytical_risk: Average review score and coverage depend on an unsupported canonical rule.
proposed_treatment: Preserve all events; approve canonical/event-grain policy later.
unresolved_question: Are repeated relationships revisions, identifier reuse, or another source-system behavior?

issue_title: Geolocation observation multiplicity and coverage gaps
affected_columns: ZIP prefix; latitude; longitude; city; state
issue_description: Raw geolocation contains repeated observations, conflicting labels/coordinates, exact duplicates, and coverage gaps.
evidence: 261,831 exact repeats; 17,972 multi-row prefixes; 8,556 multi-city; 8 multi-state; customer gaps=278; seller gaps=7.
analytical_risk: Direct ZIP joins multiply rows and geography may be misassigned.
proposed_treatment: Evaluate median/centroid/modal-label normalized ZIP reference; retain coverage flags.

issue_description: Some products lack a Portuguese category and two observed categories lack supplied English mappings.
evidence: 610 products / 1603 item rows missing; 13 products / 24 item rows untranslated; labels=['pc_gamer', 'portateis_cozinha_e_preparadores_de_alimentos'].
analytical_risk: Silent inner joins undercount category-based metrics.
proposed_treatment: Preserve missing and original untranslated values; Phase 4 approves display labels.

issue_title: Timezone metadata absent from source timestamps
issue_description: CSV timestamps are timezone-naive and the source provides no timezone field.
evidence: All configured non-null timestamps parse; no offset/timezone metadata exists.
proposed_treatment: Retain source-naive semantics and document limitation.

issue_description: Some lifecycle timestamps appear in an unexpected sequence; late delivery is separately a valid business condition.
evidence: 1,359 approval-after-carrier; 23 carrier-after-customer-delivery; zero purchase-after-approval/delivery. Violation magnitudes/statuses in temporal assessment.
analytical_risk: Duration metrics may be negative or operational sequence may be misinterpreted.
proposed_treatment: Preserve; Phase 2 evidence supports metric-specific exclusion consideration, not correction.
unresolved_question: Do timestamps reflect source-system event ordering, delayed writes, or erroneous values?

issue_title: Shipping-limit timestamp beyond source purchase window
issue_description: Shipping-limit timestamp extends to 2020 although the last purchase is in 2018.
analytical_risk: Shipping-limit analysis and chronology can be distorted for the affected row.
impacted_metrics: No current core metric; future shipping compliance
proposed_treatment: Preserve and investigate; do not infer typo or correction.
unresolved_question: What source-system event produced the 2020 timestamp?

issue_description: Eight valid source statuses have different lifecycle completion and child-source coverage.
evidence: Counts, timestamp presence, and item/payment/review presence are recorded per status; all eligibility cells PENDING_PHASE_3.
analytical_risk: A single implicit status filter would create inconsistent KPI populations.

issue_description: Delivered status can lack an actual delivery timestamp, while non-delivered status can contain one.
evidence: 8 delivered orders missing timestamp; 6 non-delivered orders with timestamp, statuses={'canceled': 6}.
analytical_risk: Delivery lead time and late-rate denominators require explicit endpoint eligibility.
proposed_treatment: Preserve status; Phase 3 evaluates status-only vs status-plus-valid-timestamp populations.

issue_title: Zero monetary values and extreme ranges
issue_description: Monetary fields are populated and non-negative, but zero freight/payment values and high ranges need metric-aware interpretation.
evidence: price zeros=0 max=6,735; freight zeros=383 max=409.68; payment zeros=9 max=13,664.08; no parse failures/negatives.
analytical_risk: Zero treatment or automatic outlier removal could bias value metrics.
proposed_treatment: Preserve all values; investigate zero contexts; never winsorize automatically.

issue_title: Source categorical labels are not normalized
issue_description: Source spelling/casing/accent variants are preserved and may represent aliases rather than defects.
evidence: Geolocation includes 8,556 ZIP prefixes with multiple city strings; no derived mapping was created.
analytical_risk: Grouping labels may fragment categories or locations.
proposed_treatment: Profile and approve mappings only in a derived layer.

issue_description: Customer behavior is observed only between the minimum and maximum purchase timestamps.
evidence: Purchase window 2016-09-04 21:15:19 to 2018-10-17 17:30:18; boundary completeness is not guaranteed by the source.
analytical_risk: Late entrants have less opportunity to repeat; recency depends on an arbitrary dataset endpoint.
proposed_treatment: Disclose fixed window, censoring, cohort exposure, and recency anchor before Phase 6 analysis.

issue_title: Non-unique identifiers at review and geolocation grains
issue_description: Identifiers/combinations that resemble keys are not unique at the observed source grains.
evidence: review_id duplicate-key rows=1,603; order_id duplicate review rows=1,098; geolocation exact duplicate rows=261,831.
analytical_risk: Incorrect uniqueness assumptions cause arbitrary deduplication or row multiplication.
proposed_treatment: Preserve source events/observations and require modeling rules.
